prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $templateFile = "$dataFile.templates.json"
    $saveWork = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Work', '--title', 'Template title', '--description', 'Template description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($saveWork.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $saveWork.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template save should be banner-free'
    $savedWork = $saveWork.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($savedWork.name -eq 'Work' -and $savedWork.description -eq 'Template description') 'template save should return the saved template'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templateFile) 'template save should create a JSON file beside the data file'
    Assert-True (@(Get-ChildItem -Path "$templateFile.*.tmp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -eq 0) 'template save should not leave a temporary file'

    $saveAlpha = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'Alpha title', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($saveAlpha.ExitCode -eq 0) 'a second template save should succeed'
    $saveBeta = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Beta', '--title', 'Beta title', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($saveBeta.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ([regex]::Matches($saveBeta.Output, 'TEMPLATE')).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON template save should display the banner once'
    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($templateList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template list should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $templateList.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template list should be banner-free'
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($listedTemplates.name -join ',') -eq 'alpha,Beta,Work') 'template list should be stably alphabetical'

    $templateBytesBeforeFailure = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($templateFile)
    $tasksBeforeFailure = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dataFile) { [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile) } else { @() }
    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'work', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template names should be case-insensitively unique'
    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', '../bad', '--title', 'Invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid template names should fail'
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ([Convert]::ToBase64String($templateBytesBeforeFailure) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($templateFile))) 'failed operations should not change templates'
    Assert-True ([Convert]::ToBase64String($tasksBeforeFailure) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'failed operations should not change tasks'

    $fromTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'WORK', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($fromTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should resolve template names case-insensitively'
    $templatedTask = $fromTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($templatedTask.title -eq 'Template title' -and $templatedTask.description -eq 'Template description') 'add should apply template values'
    $overridden = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'Work', '--title', 'Explicit title', '--description', 'Explicit description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $overriddenTask = $overridden.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($overridden.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $overriddenTask.title -eq 'Explicit title' -and $overriddenTask.description -eq 'Explicit description') 'explicit add values should override template values'
    $descriptionOverride = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'Work', '--description', 'Description only', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $descriptionOverrideTask = $descriptionOverride.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($descriptionOverrideTask.title -eq 'Template title' -and $descriptionOverrideTask.description -eq 'Description only') 'each explicit add value should independently override its template value'

    $textList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($textList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON template list should succeed'
    Assert-True (([regex]::Matches($textList.Output, 'TEMPLATE')).Count -eq 1) 'successful non-JSON template actions should display the banner once'
    $textRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'Beta', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($textRemove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ([regex]::Matches($textRemove.Output, 'TEMPLATE')).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON template remove should display the banner once'
    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'wOrK', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $removeTemplate.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE') -and ($removeTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Work') 'JSON template remove should be case-insensitive and banner-free'

    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/template.txt'
    $bannerBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = @($bannerText.TrimEnd("`n") -split "`n")
    $allowedBannerLine = '^[ A-Z0-9+|/\\_*.#():=\-]{20,48}$'
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'template banner should have exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch $allowedBannerLine -or $_ -match '\s$' })) 'template banner lines should satisfy character, width, and whitespace constraints'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('TEMPLATE') -and $bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10 -and -not ($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -eq 13 -or $_ -gt 127 })) 'template banner should contain TEMPLATE and use ASCII with one final LF'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
